NewsArticle.Title: Client 2.25
NewsArticle.Content: - 40 new clothing variations - Improved compatibility with Windows 95, which prevents some Invalid Page Faults - Mail deletion fix - Random hair/hair color at create screen Client 2.25 is available for download now, as of 3 a.m. PDT. If you have been playing, logon to Dark Ages now for the fastest auto-update.
